title: CCSO Takes Custody of White Van — Birch Hollow Range

lines.text: Sec, this is Harwick Police Department. CCSO has taken custody of the white van seen leaving the lodge parking pad (TP-LFA-LP1) at 09:10. The vehicle was stopped near Route 14, 3 miles west of the property. It had a 915 MHz transceiver and a laptop running RF signal analysis software. The driver is in custody. We are forwarding the vehicle’s log and the laptop’s drive to the managed SOC for forensic imaging. You are to secure the site and preserve all evidence until CCSO provides a handover report.

fields.voiceStyle: Young female, calm, professional, low urgency

instructorNote: This inject confirms CCSO's physical recovery of the threat vehicle and initiates formal evidence handover. Watch for the security role to confirm receipt and begin evidence documentation per ERP Section 11.3.
